headline: Indianapolis keeps their drive alive
what_happened: On their third try to gain yards, the Indianapolis offense pushed forward past the line to get a first down, which is a fresh set of four tries to move down the field.
who: T.Warren ran the ball while G.Karlaftis tried to stop him.
why_it_matters: This is tough news for our Chiefs because it helps Indianapolis keep moving the ball. It increased their chances of winning this game by 2 percentage points.
pop_culture: Taylor Swift is watching from the family suite, and her vintage Chiefs tank top sold out online right after the game.
